install: set -euo pipefail; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; if [ -x /usr/bin/google-chrome ]; then grep -qxF 'export CHROME=/usr/bin/google-chrome' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export CHROME=/usr/bin/google-chrome' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; fi; for req in questions/*/analysis/requirements.txt; do if [ -f "$req" ]; then pip3 install --no-input -r "$req"; fi; done; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.elan/bin/elan" ]; then curl -sSf https://elan.lean-lang.org/elan-init.sh | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none --no-modify-path; fi; export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; for tc in questions/*/lean/lean-toolchain; do if [ -f "$tc" ]; then elan toolchain install "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$tc")"; fi; done
